text: here is a thing i found to be true but i cant really tell you why its doing it, i never even made the selection myself to begin with, but [Image #1] these 'select Selected material' is coming from me pressing escape key
resolution: Traced Escape to the world keymap's select-tool command falling through the legacy generic edit recorder, which borrowed the boot placeholder world object's name ('Selected material') as a fabricated target. Migrated Select into the application CommandAuthority as a report-only, non-undoable command shared by hotkey, Section D, and remote callers. A real transition now emits command.outcome targeting world-tool/select-tool; repeated Escape while already neutral commits and emits nothing. Added headless proofs that no material target/action ID can appear and that repeated Escape is idempotent. ReleaseFast editor build passes.
